A unilateral compound steel mace mill using a rotational/circular outward cast. Track with reps plus weight. Primary emphasis is shoulders/deltoids and lats, with upper back/traps, forearms/grip, and obliques/core assisting; triceps and chest stabilize the cast and shoulder position.
Set your grip — Hold the mace with an upper-thumb grip and choke up to a comfortable point on the handle.
Punch toward your face — Bring your fist toward your face to initiate the mill.
Let the mace drop — Allow the mace head to fall behind you. Let your elbow naturally flare outward as the mace drops.
Drive toward the hip — Using the mace’s momentum, drive your elbow down toward your hip to cast the mace outward.
Complete the circle — Guide the mace through its circular path and smoothly return to the starting position.
Key cue: Punch → Drop → Flare → Drive → Cast.
Rep: One complete outward circle and return to the starting position = 1 rep.
